newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net Upland sales of 15,100 running bales (RB) equaled the previous week, but were 73 percent less than the 4-week average.
Major increases for Brazil (13,200 RB), Mexico (8,000 RB), Indonesia (4,800 RB), and Taiwan (2,700 RB) were partially offset by net reductions for China (12,900 RB) and Hong Kong (5,300 RB).
Net sales of 58,700 RB for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for Mexico (21,600 RB), Japan (17,000 RB), and El Salvador (13,500 RB).
Exports of 123,200 RB exceeded the previous week by 7 percent, but were 7 percent short of the 4-week average.
Asian destinations accounted for 60 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 27 percent; West European, 12 percent; and African, 1 percent.
